q01:
SELECT 
    r.name AS region,
    SUM(ol.amount_cents) AS revenue_cents
FROM 
    orders od
JOIN 
    customers c ON od.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN 
    regions r ON c.region_id = r.region_id
JOIN 
    order_lines ol ON od.order_id = ol.order_id
WHERE 
    od.status <> 'cancelled' 
    AND od.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND od.ordered_at >= '2026-07-01' 
    AND od.ordered_at < '2026-10-01'
GROUP BY 
    r.name
HAVING 
    SUM(ol.amount_cents) > 0
ORDER BY 
    revenue_cents DESC

    orders od ON ol.order_id = od.order_id

WHERE
